mission_08: Logical constraints in neural networks enforce SAT-style CNF (Conjunctive Normal Form) formulas on network outputs, ensuring predictions satisfy domain logic. Each clause is a disjunction of literals (variables or their negations), and the CNF formula is a conjunction of clauses. Continuous satisfaction is computed using probabilistic logic: clause satisfaction = 1 - product(1 - literal_truth) for OR, and CNF satisfaction = product of clause satisfactions for AND. The logic loss penalizes constraint violations with -log(satisfaction). In this mission, you implement a neural network with CNF constraint evaluation, logic loss computation, combined gradient-based training that backpropagates through both data and logic losses, and constrained prediction that reports both class predictions and constraint satisfaction scores.
